model.title: Saving Lives and Taxpayer Dollars Act
model.meta: Foreign Relations Committee · Sen. Jeanne Shaheen (D-NH)

summary.text: The bill would require that U.S. foreign aid commodities be distributed and used for their intended purposes before they expire, aiming to reduce waste and ensure aid reaches its intended recipients in a timely manner.
